claim: In Automatic mode, Amazon FSx automatically scales the SSD IOPS of an FSx for Windows file system to maintain 3 SSD IOPS per GiB of storage capacity, up to 400,000 SSD IOPS per file system.
question: How many SSD IOPS per GiB does FSx for Windows maintain in Automatic mode?

qualifiers.scope: per FSx for Windows file system, Automatic IOPS mode
qualifiers.condition: up to 400,000 SSD IOPS per file system
